core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Feyza corresponds to the Arabic form فيضا (Arabic root ف ي ض (f-y-ḍ) 'to overflow, abound'). Its core sense is abundance, prosperity. Feyza is the Turkish form of Arabic فيضة (Fayḍa), from the root ف ي ض (f-y-ḍ) 'to overflow, pour out abundantly'. Its core sense is 'abundance, overflow', extended in Turkish usage to 'grace, favour'. The source gloss 'blossom, bloom' is unsupported and has not been carried over. It is often treated alongside Faiza (فائزة), but the two derive from different roots.
